WITH inserted_order AS (
  INSERT INTO shreeji_app.orders (
    client_id,
    order_date,
    product_id,
    destination,
    notes,
    total_lots,
    total_quantity,
    created_by
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8
  ) RETURNING id, order_id, client_id, order_date, status, total_lots, total_quantity, submission_timestamp
),
status_log AS (
  INSERT INTO shreeji_app.order_status_history (
    order_id,
    previous_status,
    new_status,
    updated_by,
    updated_by_name,
    remarks
  ) SELECT id, NULL, 'Order Submitted', $8, $9, 'Initial order placement via client portal' FROM inserted_order
)
SELECT * FROM inserted_order;

INSERT INTO shreeji_app.order_lots (order_id, lot_id, lot_number, quantity, unit, calibration_date, calibration_time)
SELECT 
  $1::BIGINT,
  (x->>'lotId')::VARCHAR,
  (x->>'lotNumber')::INT,
  (x->>'quantity')::NUMERIC,
  (x->>'unit')::VARCHAR,
  (x->>'calibrationDate')::DATE,
  (x->>'calibrationTime')::TIME
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) AS x;

SELECT 
  o.id, 
  o.order_id, 
  o.client_id, 
  c.hospital_name,
  c.client_code,
  o.order_date, 
  o.submission_timestamp, 
  p.id AS product_id,
  p.name AS product_name, 
  o.destination, 
  o.notes, 
  o.status, 
  o.total_lots, 
  o.total_quantity, 
  o.created_at,
  o.updated_at
FROM shreeji_app.orders o
JOIN shreeji_app.clients c ON o.client_id = c.id
JOIN shreeji_app.products p ON o.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ($1::INT IS NULL OR o.client_id = $1)
  AND ($2::DATE IS NULL OR o.order_date >= $2)
  AND ($3::DATE IS NULL OR o.order_date <= $3)
  AND ($4::VARCHAR IS NULL OR o.status = $4)
  AND ($5::INT IS NULL OR o.product_id = $5)
  AND ($6::VARCHAR IS NULL OR o.order_id ILIKE '%' || $6 || '%')
ORDER BY o.submission_timestamp DESC
LIMIT $7 OFFSET $8;
